# IOData ORCA test fixture attribution

`orca-nh3.molden` is a byte-for-byte copy of `iodata/test/data/nh3_orca.molden`
from the [IOData project](https://github.com/theochem/iodata), revision
`9f7e800fc414b086d677b5f2882dd0c1dfa919f3`:

[Original fixture](https://github.com/theochem/iodata/blob/9f7e800fc414b086d677b5f2882dd0c1dfa919f3/iodata/test/data/nh3_orca.molden)
and [upstream regression tests](https://github.com/theochem/iodata/blob/9f7e800fc414b086d677b5f2882dd0c1dfa919f3/iodata/test/test_molden.py).

The source file identifies itself as an `orca_2mkl` export. Its SHA-256 is
`3c3a0baa0d404c091b5531fa28e8a8f51c38f4e8c263708c0173bea2923b2568`.
It contains NH3 geometry, Gaussian S/P/5D shells and real molecular orbitals.
The originating ORCA version and calculation method are not stated. No
ORCA executable, proprietary library, or IOData implementation is distributed
with these files.

> Copyright (C) 2011-2019 The IODATA Development Team

The full upstream license is preserved in [IODATA-LICENSE.txt](IODATA-LICENSE.txt).
Its SHA-256 is
`da7eabb7bafdf7d3ae5e9f223aa5bdc1eece45ac569dc21b3b037520b4464768`.
Retain this attribution and license with the copied fixture. This is a separate
test-data attribution, not relicensing of the Molekel application.

`orca-nh3.json` is a derived numerical reference generated by Molekel's
[`generate_molden_references.py`](../../../tools/generate_molden_references.py)
using the pinned independent IOData importer and PySCF evaluator. It contains
numerical data and provenance, not upstream implementation source; distribute
it with the same test-data attribution and GPL-3.0-or-later terms. See the
[fixture guide](../README.md) for independence, precision, and regeneration.
